changelog: Initial flagship release of AXSESCLIENT v1.0.0 (GENESIS X).
Native C# / .NET 8 / Avalonia UI 11 Windows Launcher (AXSESCLIENT.exe) with 13-stage direct JVM launch engine.
Separate native Fabric client mods for Minecraft 1.16.5, 1.21.4, and 1.21.11.
90 modules & GUI features, AXSES NEO-DARK 8-theme engine, HUD Editor, and Config Manager.
